decisions.reason: The accelerator program has been on the home page for two years and publicly signals the firm's ecosystem-building ambitions, so management is likely to keep it despite its distance from core machinery revenue, given its low cost and visible commitment.

The CO2-negative bitumen binder is presented as a flagship of the firm's circular, low-emission direction and has its own page, so slow uptake will likely be blamed on temporary market-adoption hurdles rather than lead to abandonment.

The WASTX Cleanic is a flagship partnership product close to the core business, has been promoted on the home page with quantified launch messaging in both years, and carries heavy invested resources and public partner commitment, making a drop very unlikely.
